entries.34de0e63155b730f: This business involves local subsidiaries in Vietnam, India and the Philippines manufacturing and selling steel tubes and surface-treated steel sheets. Maruichi Sun Steel Joint Stock Company in Vietnam manufactures and sells steel tubes and surface-treated steel sheets, Maruichi Kuma Steel Tube Private Limited in India manufactures and sells stainless steel tubes and aluminum-plated steel tubes, and Maruichi Philippine Steel Tube Inc. in the Philippines manufactures and sells steel tubes. entries.43ee5d67101ca038: This is the group's largest business, manufacturing and selling steel pipes and surface-treated steel sheets in Japan. The company manufactures and sells its products, and also purchases and sells products of Hokkaido Maruichi Steel Tube Co., Ltd., Kyushu Maruichi Steel Tube Co., Ltd. and Shikoku Maruichi Steel Tube Co., Ltd. Some of its products are sold through Maruichi Steel Hanbai Co., Ltd. Its main products include welded steel pipes for structural, building and piping use, stainless steel pipes, BA precision thin tubes, irregular-shaped pipes, plated coils and lighting poles. Revenue from external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥144,139 million.
